change_summary: Reads data/non_ohlcv/sec_filing_features_*.jsonl, filters to 10-Q/10-K/8-K-with-item-2.02, indexes by ticker, and joins the most recent filing_date <= as_of_date into each row of the exp-20260525-034 watchlist. Falls back to data/daily/snapshots/earnings/*.json next_earnings_date timelines for tickers absent from EDGAR. Writes enriched artifact to data/experiments/exp-20260527-908/; does not modify exp-20260525-034.
decision_rule: Gate 4: primary_positive_resolved_share >= 0.80 AND post-repair pead_status_counts must contain at least one inside/outside-T2-T15 bucket so downstream PEAD experiments can compare buckets.

gate2.criteria: ticker + as_of_date present on every input row

gate4.criteria: primary_positive_resolved_share >= 0.80 AND at least one inside_/outside-T2-T15 bucket present

gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260527-005/006/007 closed observed_only_data_gap citing missing_last_earnings_date; exp-20260525-025 fixed duplicate earnings snapshot guard but did not introduce last_earnings_date.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Single deterministic script over checked-in data; no live API calls; unit tests cover PIT safety + SEC item-code filtering + source preference.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: last_earnings_date PIT join into expectation revision watchlist row
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Gate 4: >=80% of primary positive rows resolve, and at least one inside/outside-T+2..T+15 bucket has rows.
gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Last earnings date can be reconstructed PIT-safely from SEC EDGAR 10-Q/10-K/8-K(2.02) filings, unblocking PEAD bucket comparison.

hypothesis: Last reported earnings date can be reconstructed PIT-safely by indexing SEC EDGAR 10-Q/10-K/8-K(2.02) filings and joining the most recent past filing_date into watchlist rows, unblocking the PEAD continuation alpha line (exp-20260527-005/006/007) whose primary positive rows were 100% missing_last_earnings_date.
next_evidence_needed: Re-run exp-20260527-005 against the enriched watchlist to obtain the first proper bucket comparison (residual vs non-residual PEAD eligible at 5d/10d). For exp-20260527-006 also persist 2d forward outcomes. For the 7 still-unresolved tickers (NVO, TSM, HOOD, RBLX, SOFI, GEV, MTSI, MRVL, SPOT, VRT, WDC), add a non-EDGAR earnings-date source (foreign filers 20-F + IPO calendar).
